records.shared_structure: claim, warrant, evidence grade, method, and knowledge domain
records.preserved_structure: claims require a licensed inferential path
records.lost_structure: demonstrative necessity, science classification, and translation history
records.conflicts: generic evidence does not reproduce burhān or its audience

records.shared_structure: cause, event, agency, constraint, and accountability
records.preserved_structure: action is decomposed across causal roles
records.lost_structure: creation doctrine, atom-event ontology, and acquisition
records.conflicts: current causal language presumes a mechanism frame disputed by the packet

records.shared_structure: possibility, necessity, identity conditions, dependence, and actualization
records.preserved_structure: a possibility can depend on causes for actuality
records.conflicts: possible is not merely an option available to an agent

records.shared_structure: causal claim, observed succession, warrant, choice, and practice
records.preserved_structure: observation alone does not prove necessity
records.lost_structure: divine choice, customary regularity, law, and spiritual end
records.conflicts: mechanism language cannot silently decide the metaphysical dispute

records.shared_structure: rule, interpretation, exception, authority, decision, and audience
records.preserved_structure: interpretation occurs under an authority regime
records.lost_structure: proof grade, revealed-law end, and audience qualification
records.conflicts: policy exceptions are not taʾwīl and product roles are not philosophical rank

records.lost_structure: knowledge by presence and luminous ontology
records.conflicts: presence metadata and physical light would be false friends

records.shared_structure: source, manifestation, multiplicity, mediation, and transformation
records.preserved_structure: one source can appear through differentiated forms
records.lost_structure: divine names, renewed disclosure, imaginal mediation, and receptive locus
records.conflicts: composition language can make disclosure into static part-whole structure

records.shared_structure: role, learned conduct, evaluation, justice, and governance
records.lost_structure: adab genre, character cultivation, and theological senses of justice
records.conflicts: organizational role metadata cannot substitute for ethical formation

records.shared_structure: rule, interpretation, disagreement, precedent, practice, and authority
records.preserved_structure: rules are enacted through interpretation and institutional custody
records.lost_structure: canonized dispute, textual genre, obligation, and diasporic community
records.conflicts: a decision engine seeks closure where maḥloket may remain authoritative

records.shared_structure: claim, source, reason, transmitted evidence, obligation, and practice
records.lost_structure: creation frame and rational/revealed commandment distinction
records.conflicts: transmission cannot be downgraded to hearsay inside its authority frame

records.shared_structure: predicate, evidence grade, interpretation, audience, rule, and purpose
records.preserved_structure: language and evidence constrain what may be asserted
records.lost_structure: negative predication, prophetic mediation, concealment, and perfection
records.conflicts: an identity field cannot positively encode what negative theology withholds

records.shared_structure: historical event, testimony, lineage, identity, practice, and context
records.preserved_structure: claims depend on transmission through a community
records.lost_structure: revelatory authority, exile, embodied tradition, and peoplehood
records.conflicts: system lineage cannot certify revelation or essentialize a people

records.shared_structure: source interpretation, causal necessity, agency, freedom, and political authority
records.preserved_structure: better causal understanding can change available action
records.conflicts: agency as option selection contradicts freedom-through-understanding-necessity

records.shared_structure: relation, subject, other, responsibility, reciprocity, and justice
records.preserved_structure: relation can constitute obligations between subjects
records.lost_structure: ethical asymmetry, irreducible alterity, face, and third party
records.conflicts: symmetric relation schemas and demographic othering both violate the source structure

custody_rule: Candidate alignments append interpretation and cannot mutate source-local records.
